rule_or_requirement: The pixel-only controller should preserve valid completion while finding faster driving actions.
observable_information: Four grayscale frames, visible road centers and obstacles, pixel HUD speed, and fixed pixel actor actions; no simulator state or map geometry at inference.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Compare four single-change directions against the frozen apex actor: bend-conditioned gas floor, exit throttle pulse, approach-rate brake, and mild-bend outer entry. Each direction has one candidate and no parameter sweep.
expected_success_endpoint: At least one mechanism changes action on TRAIN without losing a control completion, qualifying it for a separately preregistered fresh tune batch.
control: Frozen apex_line actor and exact checkpoint hashes on both registered TRAIN cells.
falsifier: A direction makes no action changes, has invalid actions, or loses a completed control cell; later fresh tune also falsifies it if completion or tied-completion lap time declines.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Four independent candidate profiles plus one common control on consumed TRAIN 1/43 and 2/102, ten episodes total, 2000 decisions per episode.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU, 1800-second profile cap, TRAIN only; no tune, held-out, confirmation, blind, upload, or submission.
